end.line: Quillon for Meridian Rail’s procurement lawyers

vo: Meridian Rail’s procurement lawyers review around nine hundred supplier contracts a year, and no two liability caps match.
Quillon keeps your positions in one playbook, learned from thirty-eight closed matters and signed off by a senior lawyer.
When the commercial team emails the same question again, Quillon drafts the reply in Outlook, cited to the clause.
In Word, every supplier draft is marked up to your playbook, with the reason beside each change.
Lukas will walk your team through it on Tuesday the tenth.
